purpose: Exact, executable run requests for measurements this node cannot perform. Each request is self-contained: target build, map, input tape, readout, controls, acceptance.

why_this_node_cannot_run_them.exact_client: WhiteStick exact-client execution is not reachable from this node
why_this_node_cannot_run_them.server_oracle: staged and working, but blocked on era-matched map+recording: a 2024/2026-era .Map.Gbx cannot be loaded by 2020-2022 servers (measured: 2020-07-01 'Can't load map for the ghost'; 2021-07-01 and 2022-01-21 'validation of 0 ghosts (in 0 maps)')

requests.goal: Resolve the open 0.09 s discrepancy in the current-build reference run
requests.acceptance: finish_plane_s reproduces either 12.79075 or 12.88075 to 1e-5 s; state which, and correct the losing document
controls: re-run twice; the two runs must agree bit-for-bit on the trace digest

requests.goal: Confirm SN-1 (2024-02-27 Snow hitbox) behaviorally, not just as geometry
requests.map_spec: flat straight; one fixed rigid obstacle whose lower edge is at a swept height h above the road, h in [0.90, 1.30] m in 0.01 m steps; finish plane 60 m past the obstacle
requests.prediction_to_test: the contact/no-contact threshold height moves DOWN by 0.095428014 m on body member 1 and by 0.169449997 m on member 2 between pre-fix and post-fix
requests.acceptance: the measured threshold shift matches a predicted per-member delta to within one sweep step (0.01 m); report the shift in metres either way
controls: identical run with the four wheel spheres' contact geometry (unchanged, r = 0.469999999 m) as the negative control — its threshold must NOT move

requests.goal: Confirm S-2/SN-2/RA-1 (2024-05-22 analog snap) behaviorally and bound the residual

input_tape.steer: ramp the analog axis to a target and hold for 5 s

requests.prediction_to_test: post-fix residual is exactly 0; pre-fix residual is > 0 and <= 1e-5 * max(1.0, max(|stored|,|target|))
requests.acceptance: report the measured residual per target to full float precision
controls: same tape on the same build with the site NOPed and restored, verifying the value flips and returns

requests.builds: all 39 distinct dedicated-server executables among the 43 dated builds 2020-07-01 .. 2022-01-21, plus 2022-02-22 .. 2022-06-21
requests.blocking_input: one era-matched map + recording per era: a map saved by a 2020-era client and a recording made on it in that era
requests.harness: tmphys validate spec.tsv /work 180 — one spec row per build: build_id<TAB>server_dir<TAB>map<TAB>ghost
requests.acceptance: a boundary is declared only where the verdict or the validated time changes between two adjacent dated builds, with both neighbours reproducing their own side at least twice
controls: identity: the era's own build must reproduce the recording exactly
negative: a build known to fail it (e.g. 2022-03-25 for the Roevhaal control) must fail
requests.note: the 2022-03-29 boundary is already Measured this way (63.546 s vs no finish); this request extends the same method backwards

requests.goal: Measure the Fall 2022 behavior delta, currently fail-closed
requests.map_requirement: a control map the 2022-09-30 client will actually load — the April-2026 map body used for REF-01 is rejected by that client, and metadata-only edits are not acceptable as an equivalent
requests.input_tape: the REF-01 tape: full throttle, no steer, 22.000 s keyhold
requests.acceptance: a claimed Fall-vs-current difference must exceed the measured discrimination floor of 0.080 km/h on finish-plane speed; timing differences are meaningful at 1e-5 s
controls: run stock current on the same map in the same session as the identity control

requests.goal: Measure the Summer 2023 ice change magnitude
requests.acceptance: report the per-gate time delta in seconds and the exit-speed delta in km/h; if both are within the discrimination floor, report NO MEASURED DIFFERENCE rather than adopting the release note
controls: 2023-06-23 and 2023-07-10 must match each other (they share handler and packs)

requests.goal: Measure the Rally custom-ice fix magnitude (2024-04-02)
controls: the encrypted Rally physics-model payload is bit-identical across this boundary (stored size 5696, sha256 a0a4c1fe0e771ca75053badd1b0b78de0dfe0f98fedcd2cb73d583020700734e) — so any measured difference must be attributable to the item-path delta or the run is not understood

requests.goal: Establish Desert and Snow control baselines, and the per-epoch acceleration curve for every family
requests.acceptance: publishes the first per-family acceleration and steering-response numbers; no behavior row is written for any family without them

forbidden: a value without a trace digest
adopting a release note as a magnitude
a claim below the discrimination floor
